historical_role_comparison.interpretation: Historical rounded plot observations and this fresh fixed-source multi-host campaign are different acquisition windows/builds/inputs. Ratios describe observed latency by role and do not establish a code regression, statistical equivalence or a byte-identical replication.

protocol.best_of_five: Minimum pooled three-repeat candidate mean per case; ratio is official pooled mean divided by selected candidate pooled mean. This is descriptive selection, not an independent validation set.
protocol.external_oracle: Separate official e27 optimum after external graph integer quantization; weights are not compared across native/external integer scales.
protocol.geometric_mean: exp(mean(log(ratio))), equal weighting of the 21 cases
protocol.mean_formula: sum(integer elapsed_ns) / sum(shots) / 1000 = microseconds per shot

repeat_variation.interpretation: Three repeated executions of the same fixed inputs; ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals or independent input replications.

scope: Completed native and external main matrices only. This audit does not certify completion of policy, statistics, PMU or whole-paper export.

checks: All 42 explicit native/reference binary identities equal their embedded sealed build binary identities
All nine nonzero observable difference rows rehashed, parsed and grouped by unique case/shot

verification_limits: Input datasets, DEMs and binaries are bound through existing sealed receipts; their large contents were not reread or rehashed in this audit.

All 378 compact native measurement, integer block, correctness, placement and lifecycle artifacts were rehashed and checked against completion receipts; native_shots.csv and input_features.csv were deliberately excluded from the final audit.

All 105 external compact scalar timing CSVs (3.15 million rows) were rehashed, integer sums recomputed, and per-shot integer weight gaps compared with the exact parity result, which existing official-oracle receipts certify. Large oracle edge lists and correction chains were not reread; independent parity/chain validation is verified from the sealed completion summaries.

External uses the first 10000 of each million-shot saved input stream. Timing ratios between native and external therefore use different input counts and their stated native timing scopes; external quantization also differs.
No measurements, compilation, job submission, runtime/source changes or full-workflow completion assertion were performed.
